# 📢  Round Robin Storybot - Changelog v2.6.0 → v3.1.2
### June–July 2026

**The bot is being featured this week as a top.gg Staff Pick! Thanks for being a part of our story!**

## 💫 New Features
> - **Scene Break Divider** — Creators can set a scene break divider (shown on its own line in story posts, centered in html exports). Type `[[break]]` on its own line in an entry and it will be replaced automatically.
> - **Inline Translation Tooltips** — `[[text|translation]]` adds hover tooltips for translated words/phrases in the HTML export. A CSS block in the export will need to be copied into a work skin (e.g. AO3) for it to render on hover instead of printing to the page.

### 🌟 Major Additions
> - **Interface Overhaul** — Streamlined Story add/manage panels to have consistent field names with one Save/Create button instead of several steps.
> - **Story Export Options** — The export button now has two options: **Export (no breaks)** strips turn numbers/names for one seamless narrative; **Export (breaks with turns and names)** preserves turn structure, but suppresses names based on story setup.

### ✨ Minor Additions
> - **Turn Thread Story Link** — Every turn thread's opening message links back to the main story thread.
> - **Auto-Remove Departed Writers** — Writers who leave/are banned from a server are now automatically removed from any story they've joined in that server.
> - **Inactive Writers Grouping** — The story status post now lists paused/departed writers under an "Inactive" heading below active writers.

## 🛠️ Improvements
> - **Server Setup Improvements** — Feed channel/role setup now uses Discord's native select menus instead of typed text.
> - **Sort by Last Activity** — `/story list` and related views surface the most recently active stories first.
> - **Export HTML Styling** —  Styling refined, with a CSS block to import into AO3 Work Skins so spoilers/translations/formatting survive posting.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
> - **Pen Name in Turn Headers** — Turn-break exports now show the writer's pen name instead of Discord display name.
> - **Status Embed Crash (Slow Mode)** — Fixed a bug that broke status refresh for slow-mode stories.
> - **Archived Thread Crash** — Fixed a crash when posting status updates/entries when a thread had been auto-archived by Discord.
> - **story_id Autocomplete** — Story commands now handle Discord submitting the visible label instead of the hidden value.
> - **Close from Active Turn Thread** — Fixed an "Unknown Message" crash when closing a story from inside an active turn thread.
> - **Multi-Page Edit Crash** — Fixed a crash on the edit panel for entries with many pages.
> - **Oversized Catchup Embed** — Displaying long catchup entries now splits  by paragraph instead of overflowing the embed limit.
> - **Status Post Refresh** — Story pause/resume/close now reliably refresh the story status post.

## 🔒 Stability Pass
> A full internal audit of the story/turn engine after v3.0 turned up a batch of hidden bugs — here are the main fixes:
> - **Story creation & metadata** — fixed crashes on submit (long summaries, rating/warning selects, clearing pen name) that could silently drop settings to defaults.
> - **Stuck turns** — fixed edge cases where a turn could stall with no one notified; now flagged for admins instead of failing silently.
> - **Secured mature-rated stories** — fixed several spots (entries, exports, tags, reminders, closing) posting into the public thread instead of the private restricted one.
> - **Draft preservation** — timeout no longer deletes drafts meant to be kept 24h; "delete my draft" on skip now actually deletes.
> - **Quick mode** — fixed a bug that could permanently block a writer from submitting on a later turn.
> - **Tagging** — fixed a race that could drop or duplicate tags approved at the same time.
-# Changelog announcements from the Round Robin Hub Server are rare, but you can disable them via `/storyadmin setup`.
